Chicago November events overview

  • Christkindlmarket Chicago (opens Nov. 20, 2026)

Top events in Chicago this November

Christmas Around the World

Opens Nov. 7, 2026
Griffin Museum of Science and Industry
Included with museum admission
One of Chicago’s most beloved holiday traditions returns to the Griffin Museum of Science and Industry, where a four-story, floor-to-dome Christmas tree anchors a celebration of global winter traditions. Christmas Around the World features more than 50 holiday trees representing dozens of Chicago’s cultural communities, complete with faux snow showers to add to the festive atmosphere.

A Christmas Carol

Nov. 13 – Dec. 31, 2026
Goodman Theatre
Ticket prices vary
The Goodman Theatre’s A Christmas Carol is an iconic Chicago theatre tradition. Charles Dickens’ A Christmas Carol brings the story of Ebenezer Scrooge’s transformation to life with breathtaking stagecraft and heartwarming performances. This year is the first that Chicago-based Tim Hopper will take the stage as Scrooge.

Lightscape

Nov. 13, 2026 – Jan. 3, 2027
Chicago Botanic Garden, Glencoe
Tickets from $16 (children) / $29 (adults); prices vary
Explore the Chicago Botanic Garden’s illuminated trails for a magical after-dark holiday experience. Lightscape features dazzling new light installations, the classic light tunnel, and plenty of interactive elements. Get your timed tickets in advance, as popular slots tend to sell out fast.

Ice Skating Ribbon

Starts Nov. 13, 2026
Maggie Daley Park
Starts at $17 with skate rentals
One of Chicago’s most scenic winter traditions, the Maggie Daley Park skating ribbon offers a one-of-a-kind winter experience set against the stunning Chicago skyline. The Ice Skating Ribbon at Maggie Daley Park offers timed slots with skates available for rent, so make sure to reserve online in advance.

ZooLights at Lincoln Park Zoo

Nov. 20, 2026 – Jan. 3, 2027
Lincoln Park Zoo
Tickets start at $7; free on select Mondays
Head to Lincoln Park Zoo for the city’s most beloved holiday lights tradition, featuring more than three million lights. ZooLights transforms the historic zoo each winter with hundreds of dazzling LED displays, a Ferris wheel with skyline views, and festive food and drinks. Check the calendar for special events featuring live ice carvers, strolling carolers, and more.

Christkindlmarket Chicago

Nov. 20 – Dec. 24, 2026
Daley Plaza
Free admission
The city’s most famous holiday market, Christkindlmarket Chicago fills the heart of downtown with magical Christmas cheer. The 30th annual edition of the outdoor bazaar features warm mulled wine (glühwein), authentic cuisine, handcrafted ornaments, and festive vendors, all inspired by traditional German holiday markets.

Winter Flower Show

Nov. 25, 2026 – Jan. 3, 2027
Garfield Park Conservatory
Free for Chicago residents; non-resident tickets start at $10
Escape the winter chill at the Garfield Park Conservatory, where the annual Winter Flower Show fills the greenhouse with festive plants, seasonal blooms, and holiday color. Wander the rest of the conservatory’s indoor gardens while you’re there, including the Palm House and Fern Room.

Inner Worlds: Visions from the Hirshhorn Collection

Now open through Dec. 19, 2026
Wrightwood 659
Ticket prices vary
One of the most anticipated exhibits to hit Chicago this fall, Inner Worlds: Visions from the Hirshhorn Collection showcases the legendary Yayoi Kusama, including two of Kusama’s iconic Infinity Mirror Rooms. The show at Wrightwood 659 will also feature works by Niki de Saint Phalle and Mary Bauermeister.

Anne Frank: The Exhibition

Now open through Jan. 31, 2027
Griffin Museum of Science and Industry
Included with museum admission
A powerful and moving exhibition, Anne Frank: The Exhibition at the Griffin Museum of Science and Industry recreates the Secret Annex where Anne Frank and her family hid during World War II. Through personal artifacts, photographs, and immersive storytelling, the exhibit brings her story to life.
